StargateDAW - An all-in-one digital audio workstation (DAW) and plugin suite

summary.one_liner: Stargate is an open-source, all-in-one digital audio workstation (DAW) and plugin suite aimed mainly at music production, with a focus on EDM.
summary.what_it_does: Stargate provides a pattern-based DAW workflow along with a built-in set of instrument and effect plugins. It includes a basic wave editor and a track routing matrix that makes sidechaining straightforward. Its mixer is modular: mixer channels are a plugin type that can be chosen per track send or mix, or skipped. The README says it runs on Windows, Mac and Linux on x86 and ARM, and that it uses Portaudio and Portmidi for audio and MIDI hardware support. It also lists an optional portable flash drive install for Windows and macOS, and support for display resolutions from 720p to 4K and above. The README links to demo projects, Sampler1 instruments, and a public domain sample pack.
use_cases: Making beats with a pattern-based sequencer
Running a DAW on low-spec hardware
Working from a portable USB drive
Recording and editing audio with a wave editor
notable: All-in-one DAW with built-in instrument and effect plugins, so no extra software is needed
Modular mixer where mixer channels act as selectable plugins per track
Track routing matrix with easy sidechaining
Stated minimum target of Raspberry Pi 4 or an old dual-core laptop with 1GB RAM
Source mirrored on GitLab and Codeberg; releases, issues and pull requests only on GitHub
caveats: The README names no installation steps, so setup instructions are not given in the README
Releases, issues and pull requests are only on GitHub, not on the mirrors
Portable flash drive install is listed only for Windows and macOS
Other platforms may be ported only if there is sufficient demand
